about_the_game:
A Desperate Fight for Survival in an Abandoned Home

Trapped in your late grandfather’s secluded house, you uncover his chilling writings about an unknown entity that prowls the night. With only the remnants of his survival attempts to guide you, you must craft tools, barricade doors, and restart the power before the creature finds its way inside.

🔦 Explore the house’s dark history and uncover its secrets.
🛠 Scavenge resources and craft essential survival tools.
🚪 Barricade doors and fortify your shelter against the unknown.
⚡ Restart the broken generator to keep the lights on.
🔫 Craft ammunition and prepare for the final confrontation.
👹 Face a relentless entity that hunts you in the dark.

The house is full of mysteries, and survival won’t be easy. Every second counts—will you escape, or will you share your grandfather’s fate?
